provenance.author: vis.gl contributors
provenance.method: Original monotone Lagrange-multiplier bisection with Decimal precision 110 and 320 updates; no production conversion code imported.
provenance.inputs: Exact stored binary64 axes and coordinates; references recomputed after input rounding.
provenance.certificate: Surface residual < 1e-60 and lambda > -min(radii squared), certifying a unique nearest footpoint.
provenance.scope: Sampled qualification only. Unqualified cases measure limitations; they do not establish a supported domain.
